summary: The Calc clipboard Text Import command, source separator modes and ruler, locale and native undo route meet the approved scope.
findings: Both upstream regression adaptations and the mounted resize and stale-selection scenarios pass. Chrome confirmed the same Unicode column boundaries and Undo after resizing to 390px.
residual_risks: The delimited preview is a bounded sample, and the browser supplies already-decoded Unicode clipboard text and session-level dialog preferences.
